sre-incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — multiple smart-routing alerts: decision-service reports cascading fallbacks, elevated p99 latency, and increased 5xx for eu-west. Pager to Alex C.
Alex C: ack, on it. joining the call. what do we know so far?
Maria G: seeing a spike in fallback decisions since ~11:18 UTC. policy rollout 9876 changed fallback ordering and introduced a variant_map tweak. lots of requests end up selecting the wrong model variant then bouncing regions.
Jordan L: confirmed the rollout. the intent was to prefer local-region variants, but config accidentally left variant_priority empty for some routes. router then falls back to region->fallback loop.
Alex C: concrete impact — requests are routing to tiny-quant variant (incompatible for some prompts), causing tokenization rejections and then triggering region fallback. clients see 502s and long tail latencies.
Priya K: are we seeing specific customers impacted? any big accounts?
Matt S: Support reports 12 customers with elevated error rates, 3 high-traffic ones (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C). tickets created, some escalated to SEs. start time ~11:20 UTC.
Maria G: quick log excerpt from decision stream (redacted):
```
{'req_id':'abc123','decision':{'route':'fallback','variant':null,'tags':[]}}
{'req_id':'abc124','decision':{'route':'eu-west','variant':'tiny-quant','tags':[]}}
{'req_id':'abc125','decision':{'route':'fallback','variant':'tiny-quant','tags':[]}}
```
Maria G: note the tags array is empty — our observability relies on route_tag being present. the telemetry consumer expects route_tag; when it's missing we can't show which policy triggered the fallback.
Jordan L: confirmed. the router write path didn't populate route_tag when variant_map fallback is used. that creates an observability gap — decision logs lack the route_tag and policy_id fields we need for dashboards.
Alex C: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback rollout 9876 (restore previous policy) 2) disable cross-region fallback temporarily 3) pin problematic routes to last-known-good variant mapping. which is fastest?
Maria G: I rolled back rollout 9876 in config-service about 2 mins ago and initiated a policy reload. verifying now.
Priya K: monitoring metrics — error rate p50 dropped a bit, p95 latency still elevated. need to confirm customer impact window. Jordan, can you own logging fix?
Jordan L: will take logging fix. quick patch to decision-logger to always emit route_tag/policy_id even for variant fallbacks. I'll open a hotfix PR and deploy to canary.
Alex C: oncall handoff — I'm handing to Jordan for next 2 hours. Priya, if anything escalates please page me.
Priya K: acknowledged, tagging incident channel and updating oncall roster. handing to Jordan at 11:34 UTC.
Jordan L: hotfix PR created: https://git/repo/pull/4321 (adds route_tag emit + schema check). deploying to router-canary now.
Matt S: CS update sent to affected customers: short note explaining transient routing instability, mitigation in progress, looking into root cause.
Maria G: after rollback verification: config-service reports previous policy active, rollout 9875, router pods reloaded. most traffic back to normal routing for eu-west.
Jordan L: canary shows decision logs with route_tag now present. sample:
```
{'req_id':'abc200','decision':{'route':'eu-west','variant':'base-8bit','route_tag':'region-primary','policy_id':'9875'}}
```
Jordan L: monitoring will continue for 30m. I'll also add an alert for missing route_tag in decision stream.
Alex C: customer impact assessment: 12 customers affected, window ~11:18-11:34 UTC (~16m). SLO blips for 3 customers. support to coordinate credits if needed.
Matt S: noted — CS will follow up with estimated impact and proposed credits for SLA.
Alex C: action items from on-call: 
- Maria: verify rollback fully (done) and add a post-rollback health check.
- Jordan: finalize logging hotfix and new alert for missing route_tag.
- Priya: create an incident page + severity timeline, coordinate with SRE for runbook updates.
- Alex: draft postmortem and assign severity/RCAs.
Maria G: PRs opened for config validation to prevent empty variant_priority in future rollouts. link: https://git/repo/pull/4322
Jordan L: hotfix merged to canary, will promote to prod after 10m stable.
Priya K: creating incident doc now, adding timestamps, attendants, mitigation timeline.
Alex C: thanks everyone — handing off continued monitoring to Jordan. I'll start the postmortem doc and invite stakeholders. :thumbsup:
sre-incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigation applied, monitoring in progress, incident moved to "monitoring".
Jordan L: taking over monitoring, will post final resolution and follow-ups in 30m.
